hints.title: Subsumption Verification
hints.text: Check first whether either string completely contains the other as a contiguous substring.

hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Overlap
hints.text: Compute the longest suffix of the first string that matches a prefix of the second string, and vice versa.

hints.title: Candidate Comparison
hints.text: Construct both merged candidates and select the shorter sequence, breaking ties lexicographically.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct substring and prefix-suffix overlap checks between two strings.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive permutation checks are meant for general NP-hard superstrings with many strings, whereas two strings only have two merge orders.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Storing candidate strings for direct length and lexicographical comparison.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handle both inclusion cases and select the minimum length with tiebreakers.
